Amcor launches UniPak Luma pots using up to 35% less polypropylene
stories.summary: Amcor has introduced its UniPak Luma range, which uses up to 35% less polypropylene than previous versions. The company says injection compression moulding allows for thinner walls while maintaining stacking performance. The pots are available in four sizes for products like yogurt and cottage cheese.

stories.title: Amcor launches new lightweight closure
stories.summary: Amcor has released the Moderna, a mono-material flip-top closure designed for one-handed use. The company says the integrated tamper-evident tab is captured within the body after opening to reduce environmental waste. It is intended to meet growing consumer expectations for convenience and sustainability.

stories.title: Heller opens third global manufacturing facility in India
stories.summary: Heller Industries has opened a 30,000 square foot manufacturing unit near Ahmedabad, Gujarat. The facility, operated by a local subsidiary, is designed to produce approximately 40 reflow ovens per month. It marks the company's third global site, joining existing operations in Korea and China.

stories.title: Guwahati municipal corporation clears vendors and warns on plastic
stories.summary: The Guwahati Municipal Corporation conducted an enforcement drive at the GMC Market in Fancy Bazar to remove unauthorized vendors from public spaces. Officials also issued warnings to shopkeepers regarding the use of banned plastic items, threatening the cancellation of trade licenses for continued non-compliance.

stories.title: Dow launches Nordel NGT EPDM for automotive sealing
stories.summary: Dow has introduced a new series of Nordel NGT EPDM, a material designed for automotive, infrastructure and consumer applications. The company claims the product is engineered to improve processing efficiency while maintaining performance standards for sealing components.

stories.title: SABIC planning Vadodara plant expansion to meet packaging demand
stories.summary: SABIC plans to expand its manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, in phases to address rising demand for advanced polymers. The company identified the packaging sector as a primary growth driver alongside automotive and healthcare. The expansion aims to strengthen the company's local manufacturing capabilities.

stories.title: India needs up to $130bn investment in petrochemicals
stories.summary: India requires an estimated $125 billion to $130 billion in investment over the next two decades to build 20 petrochemical complexes. An Indian Oil Corp executive stated this is necessary to meet a projected supply deficit as domestic demand is expected to increase 2.5 times by 2047.

stories.title: Trichy moves plastic waste to cement kilns
stories.summary: Trichy corporation has completed 500 trips sending 4,474 tonnes of non-recyclable plastic to an Ariyalur cement plant for use as refuse derived fuel. The local body says the initiative scientifically disposes of waste that would otherwise occupy space in the city landfill. The landfill remains available.

stories.title: Tomra weighs funding options for plastics recycling venture expansion - Traders Union
Novelis and Reazn develop recycled zinc alloy
stories.summary: Novelis and Reazn Group have developed a master aluminum alloy made from postconsumer recycled zinc. The companies describe the product as an innovative replacement for primary zinc with a low environmental footprint. The alloy has been validated for use in the company's German casthouse operations.

stories.title: Recycle BC and partners break ground on Delta facility
stories.summary: Recycle BC and Miller Waste Systems have begun construction on a 145,000-square-foot materials recovery facility in Delta, British Columbia. The project is designed to process 120,000 metric tons of packaging and paper annually. Completion is expected in 2028, with the facility supporting up to 200 jobs.

stories.title: Kshitij Polyline to build recycling plant in UAE
stories.summary: Mumbai-based Kshitij Polyline Limited plans to invest 25 million AED to establish a new plastic recycling facility in the United Arab Emirates. The company expects the plant to process waste plastics and e-waste. Funding for the project will be sourced through a mix of bank financing and equity.

stories.title: Covestro pilots auto scrap recycling
stories.summary: Covestro has launched a research project called CARBEX to recover BTEX aromatics from automotive shredder residue. The company describes the effort as a lower-emission alternative to conventional chemical production methods. The project is currently in the pilot phase.

stories.title: Lotte Chilsung, Freia, and Jamnica update packaging
stories.summary: Lotte Chilsung Beverage, Freia, and Jamnica have introduced new packaging featuring recycled content. The examples are featured in ThePackHub Innovation Zone, which tracks industry developments in sustainable materials. The companies are currently integrating these changes into their respective product lines.

stories.title: Recyclers raise concerns over metal export reforms
stories.summary: Industry bodies have welcomed the inclusion of India in the list of restricted export markets for waste metals. Recyclers have warned that the reforms may impact critical income streams. The sector continues to debate the balance between market access and domestic supply requirements.

stories.title: Europe’s plastic recycling facility closures threaten progress on recyclable packaging - Packaging Gateway
EU & US EPR: Still Riddled With Complexities - Packaging Digest
Extended producer responsibility shifts waste accountability
stories.summary: Extended producer responsibility laws are moving waste management accountability from governments to private companies. The shift requires firms to implement better data tracking and oversight systems to manage their compliance obligations. Accountability is now a corporate function.

stories.title: Producers unlikely to meet California reduction targets
stories.summary: The Circular Action Alliance has proposed unique challenge exemptions under SB 54, stating that producers are not currently set up to hit the 2027 source reduction threshold. The organization cited structural limitations in the current framework. The target remains in place.

stories.title: Podcast explores EPR impact on sustainable packaging
stories.summary: The Through the Line podcast examines how mandatory regulation is replacing voluntary goals as the primary driver for sustainable packaging strategies. The discussion focuses on the operational changes brands must make to align with new legal requirements. Regulation is now the primary motivator.

stories.title: Companies report confusion over PPWR labelling
stories.summary: An OPRL survey of 31 brands found that managing country-specific requirements is the primary concern for companies under the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation. Respondents also cited difficulties with updating large numbers of SKUs and creating compliant artwork. The regulations remain complex.

stories.title: EU plastic waste export restrictions take effect
stories.summary: The European Union has banned the export of plastic waste to non-OECD countries for three years. The commission stated the move ensures the EU takes responsibility for its 40 million tonnes of annual plastic waste. Applications for exceptions will not open until 2029.

stories.title: Producers face new plastic waste collection rules
stories.summary: The Environment Ministry is preparing to gazette regulations making producers responsible for collecting plastic products they introduce to the market. The government has set a target of 80 percent collection within four years. Enforcement at the household level remains a challenge.

stories.title: Croatia to expand deposit return scheme
stories.summary: Croatia will expand its 10-cent deposit return system on 1 January 2027 to include drinks cartons and additional small plastic containers. The scheme currently covers plastic bottles, glass bottles, and cans. Consumers will be able to reclaim deposits for a wider range of packaging.

stories.title: Nfinite Paper Wins Packaging Europe's award for Packaging Sustainability at 2026 Sustainable Packaging Summit - Quantisn
Nfinite Paper wins sustainability award
stories.summary: Nfinite Nanotechnology and Amcor won a 2026 Packaging Europe Sustainability Award for Nfinite Paper, a material containing 85% to 90% fiber. The award was presented in the Start-Up to New Materials category for the joint development of the flexible packaging solution.

stories.title: Tetra Pak launches carton for spoonable foods
stories.summary: Tetra Pak has launched the Tetra Reva, a paper-based carton designed for spoonable foods like yoghurt and puddings. The company describes the pack as a world first, featuring a full-top opening and a pull-ring intended to offer a point of difference from conventional foil lids.

stories.title: Paper packaging market projected to reach USD 662.3 billion
stories.summary: The global paper packaging market is estimated at USD 336.6 billion in 2026 and is projected to reach USD 662.3 billion by 2036. Growth is attributed to plastic substitution policies and e-commerce. India is expected to lead the expansion with an 8.5% annual growth rate.

stories.title: FMCG giants form PaperFlex Consortium
stories.summary: Colgate-Palmolive, Mars, Nestlé, PepsiCo, Procter & Gamble and Unilever have formed the PaperFlex Consortium. The group will fund trials to improve paper packaging performance and recycling options, focusing on practical hurdles like coatings, shelf life and manufacturing line compatibility.

stories.title: Research explores straw for sustainable packaging
stories.summary: Researchers at Teagasc Ashtown are investigating the potential of cereal straw as a feedstock for sustainable packaging. While traditionally used for bedding or mulch, the study suggests the byproduct could serve as a local and low-cost material for new applications.

stories.title: Researcher develops wood foam as plastic alternative
stories.summary: Yale Zhu has received a 2026 Mitacs Innovation Award for developing wood foam, a bio-based alternative to expanded polystyrene. Made from forest and manufacturing residues, the material aims to reduce plastic waste and create economic opportunities for Indigenous workers through upcoming pilot trials.

stories.title: Study suggests plastic alternatives may increase emissions
stories.summary: Research published in Resources, Environment and Sustainability found that replacing polyethylene packaging with paper, glass or metal could increase greenhouse gas emissions by up to 190% in the U.S. The study notes that these alternatives often increase total packaging mass by five to six times.

stories.title: Researchers create edible packaging from whey
stories.summary: Researchers at GITAM Deemed to be University have developed a prototype for edible food packaging made from whey. The project aims to reduce plastic waste while repurposing a nutrient-rich byproduct of cheese production that currently contributes to water pollution.

stories.title: Shibaura Machine debuts vertical molding line
stories.summary: Shibaura Machine is debuting its LWB vertical injection molding machines at the IPF 2026 event in Tokyo. The company is also showcasing AI-powered manufacturing tools alongside its new hardware.

stories.title: CPS introduces remote-start pallet wrapper
stories.summary: Contract Packaging Systems is supplying the SIAT OneWrap Arm in Australia. The semi-automatic wrapper allows forklift operators to start cycles and cut film remotely, intended to reduce the need for operators to dismount and manually attach film tails to pallets.

stories.title: Mesh Automation expands packing and palletizing lines
stories.summary: Mesh Automation is expanding its pre-engineered MACPac and MACPal product lines. The update includes specialized configurations for mixed-SKU fulfillment and automated handling for various industries, including food, pharmaceutical and consumer goods.

stories.title: Madhavi Offset installs new printing equipment
stories.summary: Surat-based Madhavi Offset has installed a fleet of machines from SASG UV Solutions. The new equipment includes an automatic gluing machine, a corner taping machine, a box-pressing machine and an automatic V-grooving machine to support the company's production of graphic prints and finished products.

stories.title: BW Converting acquires Italian press maker Expert Srl
stories.summary: BW Converting has acquired Expert Srl, an Italian manufacturer of flexographic printing presses. The acquisition adds central-impression and stack press designs to the company's portfolio for paper and film packaging. Financial terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

stories.title: BW Converting acquires Italian press maker Expert - Packaging Gateway
Siemens launches AI engineering agent in India
stories.summary: Siemens has introduced its Eigen Engineering Agent in India to automate tasks like PLC coding and device configuration. The AI tool uses multi-step reasoning and has been piloted with 16 customers to improve productivity in industrial automation projects.

stories.title: BW Converting expands flexo press portfolio
stories.summary: BW Converting has acquired Expert Srl to broaden its equipment offering for flexible packaging. The deal adds central impression and stack flexographic press technologies to the company's global lineup, intended to serve converters with varying production requirements.

stories.title: Wilkins Group adds palletising robots
stories.summary: Wilkins Group has invested £300,000 to add three palletising robots to its gluing lines. The machines use laser scanners to stack finished cartons and can be reprogrammed for different box sizes, which the company says provides greater production flexibility.

stories.title: Stackable container market sees structural shift
stories.summary: The global market for stackable kitchen storage containers is experiencing a split between high-volume commodity goods and premium products. According to IndexBox, demand is increasingly driven by consumers viewing kitchen organization as a lifestyle routine.

stories.title: FMCG logistics market projected to reach USD 1.98 trillion by 2033
stories.summary: The FMCG logistics market reached USD 1.39 trillion in 2026 and is expected to hit USD 1.98 trillion by 2033. Growth is attributed to e-commerce, organized retail, and temperature-controlled transport. Companies are prioritizing automation and digital tracking to improve efficiency. The market is currently growing at 4.4 percent annually.

stories.title: How packaging drives consumer loyalty - Packaging Gateway
Audit finds 38 percent of package volume is empty space
stories.summary: An international audit of consumer goods across twenty-four countries found that non-functional slack filling accounts for 38.2 percent of package volume. Surplus packaging exceeded 60 percent of volume in 39 products. The study, published in Cambridge Prisms: Plastics, notes that the average empty space height is 76.1 millimeters.

stories.title: Case sealers market shifts toward integrated automation
stories.summary: The global case sealers market is entering a phase of structural expansion as end-of-line packaging automation becomes a strategic priority. Demand is shifting from semi-automatic units toward integrated, sensor-equipped systems capable of handling variable sizes. The industry reports more disciplined procurement behavior and a more regionally diversified supply architecture.

stories.title: Corrugated plastic box market pivots to reusable designs
stories.summary: The global corrugated plastic box market is moving toward structural differentiation, with growth concentrated in reusable, application-specific designs. As e-commerce networks expand, retailers are seeking durable, brand-aligned secondary packaging. The market enters 2026 with broader demand fundamentals and a more regionally diversified supply architecture for its modular products.

stories.title: Tamper-evident shrink bands move beyond commodity status
stories.summary: The global tamper-evident shrink bands market is entering a stronger phase as regulators and retailers raise standards for product integrity. These polymer sleeves are no longer treated as low-cost commodity inputs. The industry reports a shift toward more disciplined procurement and a more regionally diversified supply architecture.

stories.title: Cardboard balers market expands amid rising waste volumes
stories.summary: The global cardboard balers market is expanding as industries face rising packaging waste and stricter recycling requirements. These machines, which compress paper into dense bales, have evolved from simple compactors into strategic assets. The market enters 2026 with more disciplined procurement and a regionally diversified supply architecture.

stories.title: E-commerce packaging market forecast to top $105 billion by 2031
stories.summary: The global e-commerce packaging market is forecast to grow from $78.4 billion in 2025 to $105.2 billion by 2031. A Smithers report suggests that automation and smart technology are transforming packaging from a simple protective layer into an integral part of retail operations and supply chain systems.

stories.title: Alterra acquires Pryme development business, plans European expansion - Plastics News
Brookfield Asset Management to acquire PGP Glass
stories.summary: Brookfield Asset Management has agreed to acquire PGP Glass, a specialty glass packaging manufacturer, from Blackstone. The company serves cosmetics, pharmaceutical, and food brands across India and Sri Lanka. Brookfield plans an AI-led transformation program for the business, with chief executive Vijay Shah remaining in his current role.

stories.title: Madison Dearborn Partners Acquires Peli BioThermal from Pelican Products and Platinum Equity - GeneOnline
Alterra acquires Pryme development business for European expansion
stories.summary: Chemical recycling company Alterra has acquired the development assets of Pryme N.V. to accelerate its European expansion. The company plans to develop a flagship facility at a site in the Port of Amsterdam. Financial terms of the acquisition and the amount of new capital raised were not disclosed.

stories.title: Brookfield acquires PGP Glass for $1.7 billion
stories.summary: Brookfield has agreed to acquire specialty glass packaging producer PGP Glass from Blackstone in a deal valued at US$1.7 billion. The acquisition adds exposure to packaging for cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, and food products. Brookfield plans to fold the manufacturer into its industrial and manufacturing portfolio as it expands assets.

stories.title: International Paper approves DS Smith spin-off
stories.summary: International Paper has approved the spin-off of its EMEA Packaging Business into an independent, publicly traded company named DS Smith plc. The separation is expected to complete on 7 December 2026. Following the distribution, International Paper intends to delist its shares from the London Stock Exchange.

Brookfield to acquire PGP Glass for $1.7 billion
stories.summary: Brookfield Asset Management has agreed to acquire Indian glass packaging manufacturer PGP Glass from Blackstone for $1.7 billion. PGP Glass produces packaging for cosmetics, spirits, and pharmaceuticals. The company operates 13 furnaces and CEO Vijay Shah stated he looks forward to working with Brookfield on future growth.

research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Multi-material PolyJet printing produces voxel-scale digital mixtures of an elastomeric photopolymer (Agilus) and a glassy photopolymer (Vero), giving a material family whose room-temperature response ranges from elastomeric to glassy. Large-deformation uniaxial compression over nearly three orders. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Geometry Reorganizes Nonequilibrium States that Gate Topological Switching in an Active Polymer
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Even under identical external conditions, a driven system can occupy distinct long-lived states with different susceptibilities to the same rare transition. We demonstrate this in a confined partially active polymer, where independent unknotted replicas occupy distinct. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Intrinsic volume fraction can decouple from hydrodynamic size in p(NIPAm-co-AA) microgels
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantifying the packing fraction of microgels is key to understanding their rheology and transport properties. Often, packing fractions are extrapolated from the hydrodynamic size and intrinsic volume fraction under the assumption that particle size and polymer. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Microscopically informed constitutive framework for stress overshoot, yielding, and strain hardening in amorphous materials
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: We develop a microscopic constitutive theory for the nonlinear deformation of metallic and polymer glasses based on nonaffine elasticity coupled to irreversible many-body relaxation. The theory predicts the full stress--strain response, from linear elasticity through stress. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Universal swelling of tangentially driven ring polymers in two dimensions
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: The interplay of tangential activity and excluded-volume interactions in ring polymers adsorbed to a surface, consistently results in the overall swelling of the ring configurations. This is in strong contrast to the case for three dimensional. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
